sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently topping the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive in exceptional form with five consecutive wins and a draw, and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have lost five of their last six matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in a fixture where the visitors, despite sitting 12th with 11 points, will look to bounce back after their recent form has been mixed. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third with 19 points, face a stern test away at Eccleshall (6th, 18 points), with both sides showing strong recent form—Bridgnorth recovering from a loss with two straight wins, and Eccleshall also on a two-game winning streak. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) entertain Wednesfield Community in what could be a competitive clash between mid-table sides. Bilston Town, fifth with 17 points, host Foley Meir (13th, 11 points), with the hosts arriving on strong form. Crewe, struggling near the bottom, face a difficult test at home against Allscott Heath, who have won their last two games. Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills in a clash between sides in the lower half searching for momentum. Brereton Social (11th) host Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points), where the visitors' dismal winless record—just one win all season—gives the hosts a genuine chance to pick up points. Finally, Shawbury United, enduring a difficult run of five consecutive defeats, welcome Barnton, who have been more consistent with a recent win after a draw.
